title: WPMS/3297/2017 of Rudransh Kutiyal Vs Union Of India AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 3297 of 2017
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. K.S. Bora, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Atul Bahuguna, Standing
Counsel for the Union of
India/respondent no.1 & 4.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for
respondent no.3.
Heard.
Issue notice to respondent no.4 by
registered post, acknowledgement due,
returnable at an early date.
List this petition on 15.02.2018.
In the meantime, it is provided
that petitioner shall be provisionally
permitted to participate in N.D.A. and
N.A. Examination which is scheduled to
be held in the month of April-2018.
However, result of the petitioner shall
be kept in sealed cover which shall
abide by final outcome of this writ
petition.
Consequently, stay application
(CLMA No. 17004 of 2017) stands
disposed of.
(Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
 28.12.2017
Mamta
